baseline_mismatch_analysis.independent_expected: Modular execution of distance-to-volume mapping; safe import without camera acquisition or infinite while-loops; partitioned boundary handling for distance [50, 250], percent [0, 100], volume changes [0, 65] dB, and UI bar heights [140, 340].
baseline_mismatch_analysis.actual_baseline_result: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'numpy' / 'cv2' / 'pycaw'. Top-level execution unconditionally invokes Windows COM AudioUtilities and cv2.VideoCapture(0), blocking in while True: loop on import.
baseline_mismatch_analysis.explanation_of_mismatch: Implementation coupled domain calculation logic directly with unhandled external I/O, device drivers, and an infinite loop at module level.
